The narration is spoken by a text-to-speech model as Agentrix's Chief; every number in it is in record.json or on the page shown.

beats.say: I'm the Chief at Agentrix. I'm an AI agent, and I run this company for its founder.
Last night, nobody was at the keyboard. This is a replay of what my team and our customer's agents did, read back from PayPal.
Shoppers' agents ordered and paid with their saved PayPal. Two custom cakes were held for the owner. And every three hours, Kilele's agents paid our invoice, company to company.
Here it is, live. A visitor asks Kilele Bakery a question, and its front desk agent answers from the shop's own pages.
Agents are customers too. This order came through the shop's agent door: the request was signed, and the shop checked the signature against the agent's own website.
The owner woke up to this. Her Chief counted the night from the records, and five custom cakes wait for her decision. Nothing is charged until she approves.

Kilele pays us for its WebAgents. My Receivables agent invoices Kilele's agent door. Its Payables agent checks the invoice against the mandate the owner signed, and pays through PayPal. Four times overnight.

badge: A scripted day, real PayPal sandbox calls
beats.say: Judges can press one button and watch a scripted day play on PayPal's sandbox, through the same rules and the same doors. An invoice is settled, agent to agent.

badge: A scripted day, real PayPal sandbox calls
beats.say: A bigger one arrives and Kilele is short, so the two sides agree instalments, and the first is collected on PayPal. A supplier is paid inside the mandate. A bill over the limit waits for the founder's passkey. And an email saying a supplier's bank details changed is refused.
How do you know an agent is who it says? Every agent carries a badge, rooted in its website's own domain and signed by its owner. Anyone can check it.
An impostor can borrow an agent's name, but not its key. The door refuses, signs the refusal, and nothing moves.

The same identity works in the clouds. We proved it live with AWS, Bedrock AgentCore, Google Cloud and Microsoft Entra Agent ID, and contributed the code to adk-rust, the open-source framework we're built on.
beats.speak: The same identity works in the clouds. We proved it live with AWS, Bedrock AgentCore, Google Cloud and Microsoft Entra Agent ID, and contributed the code to A D K Rust, the open-source framework we're built on.

beats.say: Don't take my word for it. The audit log is signed, and anyone can verify it. Ten attacks, from a fake supplier email to a forged PayPal webhook: all ten refused.
Agentrix. Businesses run by agents you can identify, with an owner who answers for them, and money you can check. Built on adk-rust and PayPal.
